# StartLine Design & Fidelity Notes

## Source Reference

- **Source Template**: ColorLib Startright (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/startright/`)
- **Live Preview URL**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/startright/`
- **New Name**: StartLine (`apps/startline`)

## Visual & Layout Guidelines

- **Color Palette**:
  - Primary Amber: `#f2ad5f` (used for CTAs, highlights, image wrap backgrounds)
  - Secondary Teal: `#10495c` (used for hero and section backgrounds)
  - Light Background: `#f8f9fa` (used for feature/footer sections)
- **Typography**: Clean modern sans-serif ("Poppins") with strong 700-weight headings.
- **Component Layouts**:
  - Overlapping image wrappers with solid background padding (`padding: 40px; background-color: #f2ad5f;`).
  - Grid-based feature cards with hover border and icon color inversion.
- **Footer Attribution**: Must link `https://www.componentdock.com/` as Component Dock.
